name: Xiamen Jiarong Technology Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Jiarong Technology Corp.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmental protection equipment. The company offers tubular ultrafiltration membrane equipment, spiral wound separation membrane equipment, and DT/ST membrane equipment, and containerized mobile complete sets of equipment. It also provides high-concentration wastewater treatment services and resource recycling services, a well as research, development, production, and sales of special membrane separation materials and components. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
